mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, leading to higher present values of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 240.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages indicates robust aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising wage pressures from low unemployment accelerate inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates, which suppresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 145000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which increases recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150.0 (thousands of units) signals weakening residential construction, which reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1150.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
